mdcw_dp_start_slot = {

 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_1 } } mdcw_dp_start_slot_1 = yes }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_2 } } mdcw_dp_start_slot_2 = yes }
 mdcw_dp_policy_totals = yes

}

mdcw_dp_start_slot_1 = {

 set_variable = { gw_dp_new_slot = 1 }
 set_country_flag = gw_dp_active_1
 set_variable = { gw_dp_host_1 = gw_dp_target }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_type_1 = gw_dp_new_type }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_cohort_1 = gw_dp_new_k }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_available_1 = gw_dp_stock }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_returned_1 = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_bill_1 = gw_dp_new_k }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_new_type = 3 } } divide_variable = { gw_dp_bill_1 = 10 } }
 else = { divide_variable = { gw_dp_bill_1 = 100 } }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_trade_relief_1 = gw_dp_new_k }
 multiply_variable = { gw_dp_trade_relief_1 = -0.03 } divide_variable = { gw_dp_trade_relief_1 = 100 }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_new_type = 1 } } country_event = { id = mdcw_dp.31 days = 180 } }
 else = { country_event = { id = mdcw_dp.41 days = 365 } }
 add_to_variable = { gw_ui_dirty = 1 }

}

mdcw_dp_complete_skill_1 = {

 set_temp_variable = { gw_lookup_origin = FROM.id } mdcw_gw_find_origin = yes
 set_variable = { gw_move_origin = FROM.id } set_variable = { gw_move_index = gw_index }
 set_variable = { gw_skill_credit = FROM.gw_dp_returned_1 }
 set_variable = { gw_skill_max = FROM.treasury } multiply_variable = { gw_skill_max = 10 }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_skill_max min = 0 max = FROM.gw_dp_cohort_1 }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_skill_credit min = 0 max = gw_skill_max }
 set_variable = { gw_move_k = gw_skill_max } subtract_from_variable = { gw_move_k = gw_skill_credit }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_move_k min = 0 max = FROM.gw_dp_available_1 }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_move_index > -1 } } clamp_variable = { var = gw_move_k min = 0 max = gw_stock^gw_move_index } }
 else = { set_variable = { gw_move_k = 0 } }
 set_variable = { gw_move_mode = 3 }
 mdcw_dp_move_population = yes
 set_variable = { gw_skill_funded = gw_skill_credit } add_to_variable = { gw_skill_funded = gw_move_actual_k }
 set_variable = { gw_skill_bill = gw_skill_funded } divide_variable = { gw_skill_bill = 10 }
 set_variable = { gw_skill_compensation = gw_skill_bill } divide_variable = { gw_skill_compensation = 2 }
 set_variable = { gw_skill_research = gw_skill_funded } multiply_variable = { gw_skill_research = 0.002 }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_skill_research min = 0 max = 0.03 }
 add_to_variable = { treasury = gw_skill_compensation }
 FROM = {
  subtract_from_variable = { treasury = ROOT.gw_skill_bill }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_research_factor = ROOT.gw_skill_research }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_research_factor > 0 } }
   set_country_flag = gw_dp_research country_event = { id = mdcw_dp.70 days = 730 }
  }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_funded = ROOT.gw_skill_funded }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_credited = ROOT.gw_skill_credit }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_new = ROOT.gw_move_actual_k }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_bill = ROOT.gw_skill_bill }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_compensation = ROOT.gw_skill_compensation }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_research = ROOT.gw_skill_research }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_source1 = ROOT.gw_move_first_people }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_source2 = ROOT.gw_move_second_people }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_receipt_home = ROOT.gw_move_home_people }
  mdcw_dp_clear_slot_1 = yes
  ingame_update_setup = yes
  country_event = { id = mdcw_dp.12 hours = 1 }
 }
 mdcw_gw_recount_ledger = yes
 ingame_update_setup = yes

}

mdcw_dp_policy_totals = {
 set_variable = { gw_dp_active_count = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_remit_stock_k = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_dp_trade_stock_k = 0 }

 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_1 }
  add_to_variable = { gw_dp_active_count = 1 }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_1 = 1 } } add_to_variable = { gw_dp_remit_stock_k = gw_dp_cohort_1 } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_1 = 2 } } add_to_variable = { gw_dp_trade_stock_k = gw_dp_cohort_1 } }
 }

 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_2 }
  add_to_variable = { gw_dp_active_count = 1 }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_2 = 1 } } add_to_variable = { gw_dp_remit_stock_k = gw_dp_cohort_2 } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_2 = 2 } } add_to_variable = { gw_dp_trade_stock_k = gw_dp_cohort_2 } }
 }

 set_variable = { gw_dp_trade_factor = gw_dp_trade_stock_k }
 multiply_variable = { gw_dp_trade_factor = -0.03 } divide_variable = { gw_dp_trade_factor = 100 }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_dp_trade_factor min = -0.06 max = 0 }
 if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { gw_dp_trade_factor < 0 } check_variable = { gw_dp_research_factor > 0 } } }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_dp_programmes } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_dp_programmes } }
 }
 else = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_dp_programmes } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_dp_programmes } } }
 mdcw_dp_income_preview = yes
 if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { gw_dp_applied_trade = gw_dp_trade_factor } } NOT = { check_variable = { gw_dp_applied_research = gw_dp_research_factor } } } }
  force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
  set_variable = { gw_dp_applied_trade = gw_dp_trade_factor }
  set_variable = { gw_dp_applied_research = gw_dp_research_factor }
 }

}

mdcw_dp_departure_slots = {

 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_1 check_variable = { gw_dp_host_1 = ROOT.id } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_1 = 1 } } multiply_variable = { gw_dp_cohort_1 = ROOT.gw_retained_share } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_1 = 3 } }
   set_temp_variable = { gw_dp_counted = ROOT.gw_move_k }
   clamp_temp_variable = { var = gw_dp_counted min = 0 max = gw_dp_available_1 }
   subtract_from_variable = { gw_dp_available_1 = gw_dp_counted }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.gw_move_mode = 2 } } }
    add_to_variable = { gw_dp_returned_1 = gw_dp_counted }
    clamp_variable = { var = gw_dp_returned_1 min = 0 max = gw_dp_cohort_1 }
   }
  }
 }

 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = gw_dp_active_2 check_variable = { gw_dp_host_2 = ROOT.id } }
  if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_dp_type_2 = 1 } } multiply_variable = { gw_dp_cohort_2 = ROOT.gw_retained_share } }
